s: Which of the following books has won 2024 International Booker Prize ?
x: The International Booker Prize 2024 was awarded to the book “Kairos”, written by Jenny Erpenbeck and translated by Michael Hofmann. The announcement was made by Eleanor Wachtel at a ceremony held at Tate Modern in London. The prize money will be equally shared between the author and the translator. “Kairos” is a German-language novel that follows a destructive relationship between a young woman and an older man in East Berlin during the 1980s. Reflecting on hope and despair, the novel raises complex questions about freedom, loyalty, love, and power.
